title: Actuarial Associate Manager
description:
The Role The Actuarial Associate Manager is responsibility to manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial projects across reserving, pricing, capital, risk modelling and financial reporting. The role combines hands-on actuarial expertise with technical review, project management, client engagement and day-to-day guidance of a small team or project workstream. You will apply sound actuarial judgement to data, methods, assumptions, models and conclusions; ensure high-quality and timely delivery; explain findings clearly to clients and senior colleagues; and build team capability through coaching, feedback and knowledge sharing. What You Will Do Actuarial Project Delivery Manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial assignments across P&C reserving, pricing and insurance optimisation, captive capital and Solvency II, risk financing, and financial reporting. Define and manage scope, workplans, timelines, budgets, dependencies and quality checkpoints for small to medium projects or workstreams within larger engagements. Prepare and oversee forward-looking loss forecasts, reserve analyses, capital assessments and other bespoke actuarial models for corporate and captive insurance clients. Interpret model outputs, investigate movements and translate technical results into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Technical Review and Quality Assurance Perform independent technical and editorial review of data, methodologies, assumptions, calculations, models and client deliverables, applying reasonableness checks and actuarial judgement. Ensure work is accurate, reproducible, appropriately documented and compliant with applicable professional, regulatory and internal standards. Resolve routine and moderately complex technical issues using established methods and prior experience, escalating novel or higher-risk matters when appropriate. Maintain clear review evidence and support continuous improvement of templates, controls and quality frameworks. Lead or contribute substantively to client calls, meetings, workshops and presentations, explaining actuarial methods, findings, limitations and recommendations in accessible language. Work collaboratively with colleagues across geographies and disciplines, coordinating inputs and ensuring effective information exchange. Team Leadership and Capability Building Coordinate the daily activities of analysts and senior analysts on assigned engagements, allocate work and monitor progress against agreed plans. Coach colleagues, answer technical queries and provide timely, constructive feedback that improves actuarial judgement, communication and delivery quality. Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute to a cooperative, inclusive environment that encourages technical development and shared learning. Support resource planning, workload prioritisation, onboarding and development discussions for the immediate team. Core Areas of Work Area / Typical responsibilities P&C Pricing and Optimisation - Loss forecasting, insurance programme analysis, risk transfer optimisation and strategic recommendations. P&C Reserving - Reserving analysis, movement investigation, methods and assumptions, report writing and clear presentation of conclusions. Capital and Solvency II - Profitability and financial strength assessment for captives, review of SCR and technical provisions, assumption challenge and regulatory support. Bespoke Analytics -Risk financing, modelling tools, scenario analysis, automation, research and multidisciplinary risk projects. Experience and Qualifications Recognised degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering or another highly numerate discipline. A minimum of 8 out of 13 actuarial examinations completed toward a recognised actuarial qualification. At least 5 years of relevant actuarial experience, including experience in one or more of P&C reserving, pricing, capital, risk financing, captive insurance or financial reporting. Experience managing project delivery or workstreams, reviewing actuarial work and guiding junior colleagues. Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise reports and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Technical Tools Strong Microsoft Office capability is required. Proficiency in at least one relevant analytical or actuarial tool is expected, such as R/R Shiny, Python, Power BI, RADAR, Igloo or ResQ. The successful candidate should be able to select fit-for-purpose tools, review outputs critically and support reproducible analysis. This description outlines the principal responsibilities of the role. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, client demand and the development of the successful candidate.

title: Operation Manager - PG & Serviced Apartments
description:
FARGO HOMES is looking for a responsible, proactive and hands-on Operations Manager to manage the day-to-day operations of our PG/hostel and serviced-apartment properties. The role will involve overseeing approximately 250 PG/hostel beds , along with serviced apartments, residents, guests, staff, vendors and property maintenance. 
 This is a field-oriented, hands-on operations role . The ideal candidate should be comfortable visiting properties, interacting with residents and guests, coordinating staff and vendors, inspecting properties and personally following up until operational issues are resolved. 
 The Operations Manager will report directly to the Owner/Management and will act as the primary day-to-day operational point of contact for the business. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. PG / Hostel Operations Manage day-to-day operations of approximately 250 PG/hostel beds. Monitor occupancy, vacancies, admissions, renewals and move-outs. Coordinate resident onboarding and check-out processes. Coordinate Leave & Licence agreements, KYC/documentation and police verification. Maintain accurate and updated resident records. Handle resident queries, complaints and routine operational issues. Conduct regular property inspections. Ensure cleanliness, hygiene and overall property upkeep. Coordinate housekeeping, repairs and maintenance activities. Monitor staff attendance, punctuality and performance. Ensure residents and employees follow company rules and operating procedures. 2. Serviced Apartment Operations Manage daily operations of serviced apartments. Coordinate guest check-ins and check-outs. Ensure rooms/properties are guest-ready before every arrival. Coordinate housekeeping, maintenance and linen requirements. Handle routine guest queries and complaints. Communicate with guests through telephone, WhatsApp and other channels. Monitor guest feedback and ensure timely follow-up. Maintain required standards of cleanliness, presentation and service. 3. Reservations & Enquiry Coordination Monitor PG and serviced-apartment enquiries received through various channels. Ensure timely responses to telephone, WhatsApp and online enquiries. Coordinate with the reservations/customer-service team. Follow up with prospective residents and guests. Monitor enquiry-to-booking/admission conversions. Maintain an updated enquiry and follow-up database. Escalate pricing and other commercial decisions to management when required. 4. Staff Management Allocate daily responsibilities to operational staff. Monitor attendance, punctuality and performance. Ensure assigned tasks are completed on time. Train and guide employees whenever required. Prepare staff duty schedules. Address routine performance and discipline issues. Maintain professional conduct and accountability within the team. 5. Vendor & Maintenance Management Coordinate with plumbers, electricians, carpenters, AC technicians, pest-control agencies, housekeeping vendors and other service providers. Obtain quotations where required. Assign and track maintenance requests. Verify completion and quality of work before closing maintenance requests. Maintain records of pending and completed maintenance. Monitor recurring maintenance problems and identify corrective action. Escalate major repairs/expenditure to management for approval. Ensure vendors submit proper bills/invoices. 6. Rent & Collection Coordination Monitor PG rent due dates. Follow up on outstanding payments. Maintain an updated rent-outstanding report. Coordinate with the Accounts/Admin team. Escalate persistent payment defaults to management. Ensure move-in and move-out financial formalities are completed. The Operations Manager will coordinate collections and follow-ups but will not independently waive, reduce or settle financial dues without management approval. 
 7. Property Quality Control Conduct regular inspections covering: Cleanliness and hygiene Bedrooms and bathrooms Furniture and fixtures Electrical equipment Air conditioners Plumbing and water supply Wi-Fi Kitchen and common areas Safety equipment Overall property condition All deficiencies should be documented, assigned to the responsible person/vendor and followed up until closure. 
 8. Daily Operations Reporting Submit a concise daily operational report covering: Total occupancy Vacant beds New enquiries Property visits Admissions Move-outs Rent outstanding Maintenance complaints Maintenance completed Serviced-apartment bookings Guest complaints Staff attendance Important issues requiring management attention 9. Management Escalation The Operations Manager is expected to independently resolve routine operational matters within company policies and approved limits. The key objective of this role is to reduce the management's involvement in routine operational matters and ensure that issues are resolved at the appropriate level without unnecessary escalation.
